complexity_review: Exact BigInt/integer fraction construction and cross multiplication; no floating point. Linear parsing in input size; bounded official part lengths keep arithmetic bounded.
evidence_scope: prospective finite public-domain output/type/local-effects qualification, not universal proof
objective: Compare exact nonnegative rational values, including optional repeating decimal digits; repeating nines can equal a terminating integer.
official_domain: ASCII digits only. Integer part has 1..4 digits, no leading zero unless exactly zero. Optional decimal point followed by 0..4 nonrepeating digits and optional parenthesized 1..4 repeating digits.
provenance: Owner-provided existing implementations, independently reviewed against official public statement; original files unchanged.
